batch: OpenSSH Client and Telnet DISM source-order documentation review

sources.finding: DISM checks explicit Source locations first, Group Policy-configured locations after an explicit source miss, and Windows Update only when LimitAccess is not specified.
Add-WindowsCapability documents Source, LimitAccess, and policy-configured source behavior.
OpenSSH Client is non-satellite and has an OpenSSH-Client-Package CAB on matching Windows 11 Languages and Optional Features media.

changes: Clarified in docs/windows-component-inventory.md that NotInspected refers to the target computer effective policy, while the documented DISM fallback order is known.
Clarified that LimitAccess blocks Windows Update/WSUS lookup but does not disable Group Policy-configured source fallback.
No candidate code or catalog registration changed.
disposition: Keep OpenSSH Client and Telnet source-only candidates unregistered and unsupported. The OpenSSH LocalSource outline cannot claim network isolation; actual target policy, media completeness, dependency coverage, exact recovery and native acceptance remain open.

estimates.adjustment: No component outcome closed; ranges unchanged.
